question: Does an explicit normalized-support crop boundary remove the scale-dependent zero-fill edge artifact while preserving density conditioning, area-reference statistics, deterministic partitions and physical domains?

boundary_candidates.candidate_definition: Gaussian-filter the nonnegative count field and an all-ones support field with identical finite support and constant-zero exterior, then divide numerator by positive support before multiplying by grain optical density.
boundary_candidates.claim: a computational crop-boundary convention, not a measured film aperture, gate flare or scanner-border model

branch_rule.pass: retain normalized-support as the explicit crop boundary for density-conditioned material structure and open a separately frozen edge/nonstationarity stress
branch_rule.fail: close normalized-support and retain P4D base-pitch zero-fill evidence only

claim_ceiling: generic computational film-structure crop-boundary evidence; not a measured aperture, stock response, scanner border or product result
